reuse.summary: Tulane permits download for personal, non-commercial use. The general notice separately permits local research or educational use by nonprofit organizations with the prescribed notice; other distribution requires prior written consent. No asset-specific open license or photographer credit was visible on the OISS source page.
reuse.suggested_credit: Photo: Tulane University Office of International Students & Scholars

selected.description: Five students talking together on blankets outdoors beneath a tree, used beside Become a TUPal on the official Get Involved page.
selected.alt: Tulane students talking together at an outdoor OISS community gathering.
selected.crop: For 16:9 at 800 by 450, crop near y=45 to y=495; CSS object-position: 50% 30% retains the faces and most seated gestures.

selected.description: A student and staff member in conversation across a table with coffee and an open publication; official source alt is student and staff talking.
selected.alt: A student and staff member talking over coffee at Tulane.
selected.crop: 4:3 center crop removes little horizontal content; CSS object-position: 50% 50% works.

selected.description: Smiling students sitting together at a Tulane orientation table, with welcome materials and coffee. This is the homepage Orientations card image.
selected.alt: Students sharing a table during Tulane international student orientation.
selected.crop: For a 4:5 panel, use object-fit: cover and object-position: 70% 50%. This yields an approximately 480 by 600 crop focused on the three students toward the right. Suitable for a compact panel around 320 to 400 CSS pixels wide; this is an 800 by 600 source, not a large print asset.

selected.description: A participant dancing in a bright red outfit while others clap, with international bunting and trees visible through windows. OISS Engagement page banner; filename identifies Global Cafe.
selected.alt: Community members dancing and clapping at an OISS Global Cafe gathering.
selected.crop: Native ratio is about 3:2. For a 16:9 card, use object-fit: cover and object-position: 50% 42%; keep the dancer face and outstretched arm visible. A 4:3 compact card can use object-position: 58% 50%.
